drivingQuestion: What is the reason digging a new channel is forbidden in the sabbatical year?

segments.he: רַבִּי אֶלְעָזָר בֶּן עֲזַרְיָה אוֹמֵר: אֵין עוֹשִׂין אֶת הָאַמָּה. בִּשְׁלָמָא מוֹעֵד — מִשּׁוּם דְּקָא טָרַח, אֶלָּא שְׁבִיעִית מַאי טַעְמָא?
segments.en: § It was taught in the next clause of the mishna that «Rabbi Elazar ben Azarya says: One may not construct a new» water «channel» during the intermediate days of a Festival or during the Sabbatical Year. The Gemara asks: «Granted,» it is prohibited for him to do so on the intermediate days of «a Festival, because» in so doing «he» excessively «exerts himself» on the Festival. «But what is the reason» that this is prohibited during «the Sabbatical Year,» when only labors that enhance the growth of plants are prohibited?

edges.cueHe: רבי אלעזר בן עזריה אומר: אין עושין את האמה

edges.about: why digging a channel is forbidden in the sabbatical year, where only growth-enhancing labor is barred

positions.claim: one may not make a new channel on chol hamoed or in the sabbatical year
